What I heard from you
“I want parents to find the right tutor and book a session without everything going through my phone.”

text: Dana, owner of ABC Tutoring
Help parents choose
Filter by subject and grade. Compare prices, availability and teaching format.
textPreview: Filter by subject and grade. Compare prices, availability and teaching format.

text: Build trust
Show real tutor photos, personal introductions, credentials and testimonials.
textPreview: Show real tutor photos, personal introductions, credentials and testimonials.

text: Keep you in control
Collect requests for your approval and let you manage tutor availability.
textPreview: Collect requests for your approval and let you manage tutor availability.

text: Keep the first version simple
No payment or automated cancellation workflow. Parents can still call you when plans change.
textPreview: No payment or automated cancellation workflow. Parents can still call you when plans change.

title: Parents can request a session in one clear flow

text: Parents can request a session in one clear flow
textPreview: Parents can request a session in one clear flow

text: The prototype keeps the decision in one place and uses plain language throughout.
textPreview: The prototype keeps the decision in one place and uses plain language throughout.

text: Find the right tutor
Use subject and grade filters, then compare rates and open times.
textPreview: Use subject and grade filters, then compare rates and open times.

text: Choose the session
Pick an available time and choose online or in person.
textPreview: Pick an available time and choose online or in person.

text: Share the essentials
Enter the parent’s contact details and the student’s first name, grade and subject.
textPreview: Enter the parent’s contact details and the student’s first name, grade and subject.

text: Wait for your reply
The parent sees “pending approval” while you review the request.
textPreview: The parent sees “pending approval” while you review the request.

text: See every request
Parent, student, tutor, subject, format and requested time appear together.

text: Approve on your schedule
A request stays pending until you decide. Approval removes that time from availability.
